claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_creature_consumes_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing on_caster_spends_action trigger is scoped to the caster only. Goodberry's core mechanic fires when ANY creature spends a Bonus Action to eat one of the created objects — not just the caster. A new trigger variant is needed for 'a creature spends a specified action economy cost to interact with / consume one of the attached objects.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point

claude_proposed_widenings.name: nourishment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The berry provides one day of nourishment — a survival-system mechanic with no corresponding effect atom. This may be DM-agenda (narrative sustenance tracking belongs to the caller), but it is listed as a mechanical effect of eating the berry alongside the HP restoration, so it warrants at least a surface note.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day
